evidence: Single package ('chatmock') with 28 files indicates one deployable unit
Clear module separation by concern (routes_*, responses_api, session, model_registry, etc.) with low coupling and high cohesion
Flask-based web framework usage with blueprints (routes_openai, routes_ollama) for HTTP routing
Shared domain models (models.py, model_registry.py, session.py) used across modules
CLI (cli.py), GUI (gui.py), and web app (app.py) all depend on the same core module
No inter-service communication patterns (e.g., no gRPC, message queues, or service discovery)
Directory depth of 2 and minimal package count (1) rule out microservices
All business logic resides in one codebase with explicit internal dependencies between modules
risks: Tight coupling between modules (e.g., routes_ollama imports from responses_api, session, upstream) could hinder future modularity
Monolithic deployment may limit scalability and team autonomy at scale
Shared session state in session.py could become a bottleneck or source of concurrency bugs
